_comment: Curated Slayer data for generate_slayer.py: master pages, cards and replacements; required equipment per task (filled in by the verification pass); location → access_routes.json key. locationAccess values: an access_routes.json key, 'sailing' (boat-only islands, untracked), or 'excluded' (kills there don't count, e.g. Nightmare Zone).

masters.name: Turael

replacedBy.note: Aya replaces him 'during and after the events of While Guthix Sleeps'. Same task list, shared block list.

masters.notes: No requirements. Tasks give 0 points and can reset another master's task (which also resets your streak).

masters.name: Spria
masters.notes: Turael's task list plus sourhogs. 0 points. Block list shared with Turael/Aya. She can't swap tasks like Turael can.

masters.name: Krystilia
masters.notes: She stands in Edgeville (no gate), but 'tasks assigned by her must be done within the Wilderness'. Hence access=wilderness for her tasks. She ignores combat level, keeps a separate streak counter, gives 25 points per task and drops Larran's keys. F2P NPC (members=No).

masters.name: Mazchna
masters.notes: Also needs Priest in Peril to reach Canifis. 6 points per task.

masters.name: Vannaka
masters.notes: The Edgeville Dungeon entrance west of the Cooks' Guild needs a brass key; the main trapdoor doesn't. 8 points.

masters.name: Chaeldar
masters.notes: 'The only ways to reach her are to use any fairy ring to go to Zanaris, or entering the shed in the Lumbridge Swamp whilst wielding a Dramen staff or Lunar staff.' 10 points.

masters.name: Konar
masters.notes: 'Monsters must be killed in specified locations.' She also assigns one location per task (see konarLocations per task) and never sends you into the Wilderness except for boss tasks. Drops brimstone keys. 18 points (20 with the elite Kourend & Kebos Diary).

masters.name: Nieve

replacedBy.note: 'After the events of Monkey Madness II, Steve replaces Nieve as the Slayer Master in the Tree Gnome Stronghold.' Same spot and task list. Before MM2 Steve is a Slayer guardian in the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon, not a master.

masters.notes: 12 points (15 with the elite Western Provinces Diary).

masters.name: Duradel

replacedBy.note: Kuradal (his daughter) replaces him after WGS, with the same requirements.

masters.notes: There's no access_routes key for Shilo Village. The Shilo Village quest is the gate ('to be able to enter Shilo Village ... players must have completed the Shilo Village quest'). Reach him via the ladder in the fishing shop south of the river. 15 points.

masters.name: Mortimer
masters.notes: Fallen From Grace only needs to be partially done (to enter Wyrmscraig Cavern). Wyrmscraig 'requires 62 Sailing to access', and Fallen From Grace itself needs 62 Sailing, 60 Crafting, 47 Runecraft, 53 Mining and Pandemonium. He was added 29 July 2026 and only assigns tasks that have superior variants. You pick from 2 tasks (3 after 50 tasks). He gives 0 points unless you take the points 'Mortifier'. Only 2 block slots, skips cost 100 points, and Turael can't skip his tasks. With 99 Slayer the cape bypasses the combat requirement (as it does for every master).

equipment.label: Nose peg or Slayer helmet
equipment.note: Also needed for deviant/repugnant spectres

aberrant spectre.notes: Monster list matches the wiki Monster Variants table (aberrant, abhorrent, deviant, repugnant). Konar only sends players to Catacombs/Slayer Tower/Stronghold per her location rules.
aberrant spectre.wiki: 'A nose peg or Slayer helmet is required when fighting aberrant spectres.' 'Deviant and Repugnant spectres share the requirement of a nose peg or Slayer helmet'

locationGates.note: Reached by fairy ring ALR (the wiki tags it {{Fairycode|alr}}), which needs partial Fairytale II.
Abyssal Sire is in the Abyssal Nexus, reached through the Abyss (Enter the Abyss miniquest). Check that the 'abyss' access key already covers this.
The basement demons are task-only.

abyssal demon.notes: The monster list matches the wiki variant table (Abyssal demon, Catacombs version, Greater abyssal demon superior, Abyssal Sire boss). Duradel's alternative 'Reanimated abyssal' doesn't count under Lottie's rules and isn't in the wiki variant table. No Slayer equipment is required. The teleport anchoring scroll is only recommended.
abyssal demon.wiki: 'Players on abyssal demon tasks may also opt to kill the Abyssal Sire boss instead'; variant table: Abyssal demon / Abyssal demon (Catacombs) / Greater abyssal demon / Abyssal Sire.

locationGates.note: Sailing island (already mapped 'sailing').

ankou.notes: Monster list matches the wiki Monster variants table (Ankou + Dark Ankou). Dark Ankou only spawn during the Skotizo fight (Catacombs, needs a Dark totem); auto-dying ones after Skotizo dies don't count. Krystilia tasks must be done in the Wilderness; only the Wilderness locations count for her. For Krystilia: Wilderness Slayer Cave, The Forgotten Cemetery. 'Sepulchre of Death' is the bottom floor of the Stronghold of Security, so the two entries are the same place.
ankou.wiki: Monster variants: Ankou (Catacombs, Stronghold of Security: Sepulchre of Death, Stronghold Slayer Cave, Forgotten Cemetery, Wilderness Slayer Cave, Deepfin Mine); Dark Ankou: 'Only summoned during the Skotizo boss fight.'

locationGates.note: Ynysdail 'requires 73 Sailing' and a boat with an adamant keel or better; the rowboat from Gwenith also needs Song of the Elves.

aquanite.notes: Generated monster list was empty. Elder aquanite is the superior (Bigger and Badder). Task also needs 73 Sailing (wiki infobox otherreq). Nieve/Duradel need the Lured In unlock (80 pts); Mortimer assigns by default.
aquanite.wiki: 'Aquanites are Slayer monsters found in the Ynysdail Cavern beneath Ynysdail. They require level 78 Slayer to fight, and Ynysdail requires level 73 Sailing to access.'

araxyte.notes: Monster list matches the wiki (2x Araxyte levels 96/146, Dreadborn Araxyte, Araxxor). Araxxor's minions (Mirrorback/Ruptura/Acidic Araxyte) do NOT count; correctly absent. No required equipment (anti-venom only recommended). Wiki infobox also lists Turael/Spria, but only indirectly via a Spiders task.
araxyte.wiki: 'Araxxor's minions also spawn here; killing these awards experience but does not count towards the kill count on the slayer task'

locationGates.note: The God Wars Dungeon page says entry 'requires partial completion of Troll Stronghold (defeating Dad) or full completion of the Easy Combat Achievements'. The task infobox says only 'Death Plateau', so otherReq may understate it. A rope is also needed for the first entry.
Kree'arra, Flight Kilisa, Wingman Skree and Flockleader Geerin: '70 Ranged, a crossbow and mith grapple required to access' (cards: Crossbow, Mith grapple).

aviansie.notes: The monster list matches the wiki. Aviansie can 'only be harmed with ranged and magic' (or salamanders/halberds), which is a combat-style limit, not a Slayer item. Spiritual warriors/rangers/mages don't count. 'Reanimated aviansie' (Nieve/Duradel alternatives) is excluded. Unlock: 'Watch the birdie' (80 points, needs 60 Agility or 60 Strength).
aviansie.wiki: 'Kree'arra and his bodyguards can be killed as alternatives for an aviansie task, but not the Armadylean-aligned spiritual warriors...'

bandit.notes: All five counting NPCs already listed (Bandit, Guard Bandit, Speedy Keith, Donny the lad, Black Heather). Krystilia only. All locations are in the Wilderness. No equipment.
bandit.wiki: 'Along with Bandits and Guard Bandit, Speedy Keith, Donny the lad, and Black Heather can be killed to satisfy the task.'

banshee.notes: Monster list matches the wiki variants table. 'Bloodthirsty' banshee variants are Trailblazer Reloaded League only; don't add. Slayer Tower = morytania (Priest in Peril).
banshee.wiki: 'Players must wear earmuffs or a Slayer helm when fighting banshees.'

equipment.label: Mirror shield or V's shield
equipment.note: V's shield also works but has no TCG card

routes.label: V's shield — no card; made during The Fremennik Exiles (needs Slayer 60, Defence 40 to wield)

locationGates.note: Eastern basilisk rooms and the basilisk knight rooms are only accessible after The Fremennik Exiles.

basilisk.notes: The Jormungand is listed on the wiki but 'Fought during The Fremennik Exiles, can only be fought once', so it should not make the task doable (remove, or keep but never count). Wiki also notes a 20 Defence requirement for the task.
basilisk.wiki: 'When fighting any basilisk, the player must equip a mirror shield or V's shield'; Jormungand's Prison rooms: 'Only accessible after completion of The Fremennik Exiles.'

locationGates.note: Also needs a light source (unless the fire of eternal light is built) and a Witchwood icon (card 'Witchwood icon') to protect from cave horrors.
'Requires a certain amount of progress in Legends' Quest.'

bat.notes: The monster list matches the wiki (Bat, Giant bat, Albino bat, Death wing). Dire bats in Vampyrium do NOT count. No Slayer equipment.
bat.wiki: 'Although they are called bats, dire bats in Vampyrium do not count towards this Slayer task.'

locationGates.note: Medium Wilderness Diary (or a Callisto boss task) + 50k lair fee.
Hard Wilderness Diary (or a Callisto boss task; a bear task doesn't bypass it) + 50k lair fee.
50k Wilderness boss-lair fee (shared).
Grizzly bear cubs need partial Regicide.
Partial Regicide.

bear.notes: The 'Grizzly bear' entry has a bogus location ('Grizzly bear', from 'See Grizzly bear#Locations'); replace it with the Grizzly bear page's locations (Aldarin, Gloomthorn Trail and Custodia are Varlamore; Kebos/Land's End are Kourend; Ferox and Dark Warriors' Fortress are Wilderness). Don't count: Reanimated bear (listed by Spria; the brief excludes reanimated), Angry bear (Tolna's rift), Headless Beast, Crystalline/Corrupted Bear. 'Song of the Elves' is a generated location from the 'West of Lletya (during Song of the Elves)' line, not a place. Krystilia tasks must be done in the Wilderness; only the Wilderness locations count for her. For Krystilia that means Callisto, Artio, Escape Caves grizzlies, and the grizzlies NW of Ferox Enclave / NW of Dark Warriors' Fortress.
bear.wiki: 'Black bears, bear cubs, grizzly bears, grizzly bear cubs, reanimated bears, Artio, and Callisto can all be killed... Angry bears..., the Headless Beast..., and the Crystalline and Corrupted Bear... do not count.' 'Accessing Artio requires completion of the Hard Wilderness Diary, while Callisto only requires the Medium Wilderness Diary.'

bird.notes: Mounted terrorbird's wiki page and card are 'Mounted terrorbird gnome' (ids 2067/2068 match the card). Duckling and Evil Chicken carry the Birds slayer category (Spria's table also lists Duckling). Baby Roc and Giant Roc are one-time My Arm's Big Adventure fights ('can only be fought once'), so drop Baby Roc. Large chicken (Scrambled! quest), the Icyene Graveyard seagull (Sins of the Father) and the NMZ versions are quest-only or NMZ, so leave them out. Per-monster caveats: Chompy birds need Big Chompy Bird Hunting and 'can only be damaged by ogre bow or ogre comp bow with ogre arrows or brutal arrows' (card: 'Comp ogre bow'; there are no cards for ogre bow, ogre arrows or brutal arrows). Vultures 'cannot be harmed by melee while flying' and need desert heat protection. Oomlie birds need partial Legends' Quest (Kharazi Jungle). Crash Island and Ape Atoll birds need Monkey Madness I progress. 'Birds introduced with the Sailing skill do not reward Slayer experience and thus do not count.'
bird.wiki: Variants table; Sailing birds 'do not count towards task completion'.

locationGates.note: Demonic gorillas; not valid for Krystilia or Konar tasks.

Partial completion of Troll Stronghold plus 60 Strength or 60 Agility; a Rope is needed on the first visit. GWD-related Slayer assignments need Death Plateau. Balfrug Kreeyath is in K'ril's room: 70 Hitpoints for the Zamorak bridge and 40 Zamorak killcount.
Porazdir only appears during the Mage Arena II miniquest or when re-obtaining the imbued Zamorak cape (needs Mage Arena I first).
Requires 60 Sailing.
Skotizo's lair needs a Dark totem (card 'Dark totem').

black demon.notes: Kolodion (final form) is only fought during the one-time Mage Arena I miniquest, so it should not make the task doable. Rest of the list matches the wiki. Taverley Dungeon black demons need a dusty key or 70 Agility.
black demon.wiki: Demonic gorilla: 'Requires completion of Monkey Madness II'; Kolodion: 'During Mage Arena I'; Skotizo: 'whose lair requires the use of a dark totem to enter'

quests: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze
locationGates.note: Partial Freeing Sir Amik Varze, plus a raw chicken offered at the Chicken Shrine in Zanaris (needs Lost City). Babies need a rope too. Cards: Raw chicken, Rope.
Dusty key (card 'Dusty key') or 70 Agility for the dragon area. The baby area is task-only.
Brutal black dragons need 77 Slayer.

black dragon.notes: The monster list matches the wiki (baby, adult, Wilderness Slayer Cave level 247, King Black Dragon, brutal). Dragonfire protection isn't added as required equipment: babies don't breathe fire, and for chromatic dragons Protect from Magic counts as protection. Konar's list mentions the Myths' Guild Dungeon, which isn't in the wiki variant table.
black dragon.wiki: 'Players can additionally kill baby black dragons, brutal black dragons, or the King Black Dragon as alternatives'; 'Mynydd requires completion of Song of the Elves'; 'The Corsair Cove Cave requires completion of Dragon Slayer II'.

black knight.notes: No task page. Only assigned by Krystilia, so only Wilderness black knights count: Lava Maze and NE of the Bone Yard (Krystilia's table says 'South of Silk Chasm, Lava Maze'). The others (Black Knights' Fortress, Taverley Dungeon, N of Varrock, S of Draynor bank, Jolly Boar Inn) are listed for completeness but are outside the Wilderness. Planner should keep only the Wilderness ones (Lava Maze, Bone Yard/Silk Chasm area).
black knight.wiki: Black Knight locations: North of Varrock; NE of Bone Yard (Wilderness); South of Draynor Village Bank; Black Knights' Fortress; Jolly Boar Inn; Lava Maze (Wilderness); Taverley Dungeon. Krystilia: 'South of Silk Chasm, Lava Maze'.

locationGates.note: Wiki: 'Access to the complete laboratory is granted after the player kills the mutated bloodveld that appears during the Sins of the Father quest' (partial completion).
Wiki GWD: 'Accessing it requires partial completion of Troll Stronghold (defeating Dad)'; entering the main dungeon also needs 60 Strength (boulder) or 60 Agility (crack); a rope the first time.
In the Wilderness (level 28-32).
'76 Sailing is required to access this area.'
'This location can only be accessed after completion of Song of the Elves.'

bloodveld.notes: Monsters match the variants table. The wiki says reanimated bloodveld DO count ('Reanimated bloodveld count towards the task'), which contradicts the brief's assumption. Keep it with card null; it would need Arceuus Expert Reanimation plus an 'Ensouled bloodveld head' card. Insatiable superiors can't spawn from the GWD bloodveld. Krystilia: only the Wilderness GWD counts. Konar's alternatives in the generated data look like locations rather than monsters. Her real list is in konarLocations; she sends you to Mutated Bloodveld at Catacombs, Iorwerth and Meiyerditch. Mortimer assigns Bloodveld (wiki Mortimer task table, 120-180), but the generated assignedBy leaves him out.
bloodveld.wiki: Meiyerditch: 'only accessible with partial completion of Sins of the Father'; 'reanimated bloodveld count towards the task'.

locationGates.note: 'requires a dusty key or level 70 Agility' (card 'Dusty key').
From the Dragon Nest page: 'Completion of Children of the Sun is required to access the Rainforest, but the Nest has no other requirements.'
Vorkath.

blue dragon.notes: The monster list matches the wiki (baby, adult, brutal, Vorkath). Babies don't breathe fire, so dragonfire protection isn't marked as required. Isle of Souls Dungeon has no quest gate.
blue dragon.wiki: 'The Heroes' Guild requires completion of Heroes' Quest'; 'The Ogre Enclave requires completion of Watchtower'; 'The Corsair Cove Dungeon requires completion of Dragon Slayer II'; 'The Ruins of Tapoyauik requires completion of The Heart of Darkness'.

bos.notes: Boss tasks pick a specific boss; the generated record has no monsters. Doability should come from the boss list (BOSS_DATA / boss task table on 'Boss task'), not from this record. Not verified per boss in this batch.

locationGates.note: 'Players can enter the dungeon by digging with a spade' near the windswept tree; 'accessible during and after Olaf's Quest'.

brine rat.notes: There's no task page. The only monster is the Brine rat (Brine Rat Cavern, east of Rellekka). Assignment needs 47 Slayer, 45 combat and Olaf's Quest.
brine rat.wiki: Brine rat: 'They are only assigned to players who have completed Olaf's Quest.'

catablepon.notes: No task page. Catablepon (levels 49/64/68) are only in the Stronghold of Security, Pit of Pestilence (3rd level). This entry supplies locations for the existing empty-location monster. No alternatives in Mazchna's table, and no required equipment.
catablepon.wiki: 'They are found on the third level of the Stronghold of Security.'

equipment.label: Light source
equipment.note: Both cave bug dungeons are dark. Candle covers lit candle and Torch covers lit torch (via aliases). Black candle, sapphire lantern and the Firemaking cape have no card.

locationGates.note: A rope is needed the first time you enter from the swamp (card 'Rope'), or start The Lost Tribe and use a pickaxe for the castle-cellar route. A spiny helmet or Slayer helmet is recommended against wall beasts.
Level 6 and level 96 bugs. Fairy ring AJQ.

cave bug.notes: There's no task page. This is the full list from the monster page: one monster (levels 6 and 96), and monstersAdd replaces the generated entry, which had empty locations. Needs 7 Slayer.
cave bug.wiki: 'They are found in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves, requiring a light source and a rope to enter, and stronger variants can be located in the Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon... only be accessed after the completion of the Death to the Dorgeshuun quest'; 'A light source is required for these dungeons'.

locationGates.note: Ruins are only reachable after completing the quest.

Dark: needs a light source (cards: Candle, Torch, Oil lamp, Candle lantern, Oil lantern, Bullseye lantern, Mining helmet, Kandarin headgear, Bruma torch, Abyssal lantern) and a tinderbox to light most of them.

Dark: needs a light source (cards: Candle, Torch, Oil lamp, Candle lantern, Oil lantern, Bullseye lantern, Mining helmet, Kandarin headgear, Bruma torch, Abyssal lantern; plus Tinderbox) and a Rope the first time. Open flames can explode, so a lantern is safer.

cave crawler.notes: Monster list correct (Cave crawler + superior Chasm Crawler). Fremennik Slayer Dungeon has no quest or item gate, so the task itself needs no equipment.
cave crawler.wiki: Ruins of Tapoyauik cave crawlers: 'Requires completion of The Heart of Darkness in order to access.' Lumbridge Swamp Caves: 'The caves require a light source.' Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon: 'Entry to the dungeon requires completion of the Death to the Dorgeshuun quest. The dungeon is dark.'

cave horror.notes: Monsters match (Cave horror + Cave abomination superior). No hard equipment gate. The wiki says 'You must wear a witchwood icon to fight cave horrors at melee distance', but the special attack 'can be completely mitigated by using Protect from Melee, or using a safespot'. A light source is needed 'to fight them without taking additional damage, unless a fire of eternal light is lit'. If you want a soft gate: {label:'Witchwood icon or Slayer helmet', cards:['Witchwood icon','Slayer helmet']}. Light source cards: Candle lantern, Oil lantern, Bullseye lantern, Oil lamp, Torch, Mining helmet. Mos Le'Harmless = mos_le_harmless (Cabin Fever).
cave horror.wiki: 'Cave horrors are found exclusively in the Mos Le'Harmless Cave, requiring completion of Cabin Fever.'

locationGates.note: No quest; task-only area.

cave kraken.notes: List matches the wiki (Cave kraken, Kraken). No required equipment (fishing explosives only recommended). Wiki infobox also lists 50 Magic as a skill requirement for the task.
cave kraken.wiki: skillreq = Slayer 87, Magic 50; 'Fishing explosives are recommended to initiate the fight quickly'

equipment.label: Light source
equipment.note: Exposed flames (candle, torch) can explode in the northern swamp-cave room, so a covered lantern is safer. Candle covers lit candle and Torch covers lit torch via aliases.

locationGates.note: A rope is needed the first time you enter (card 'Rope').
Dark dungeon: 'requires the player to have a light source'.

cave slime.notes: There's no task page. Full list: Cave slime (level 23) only, and monstersAdd replaces the generated entry, which had empty locations. Needs 17 Slayer. Poison protection is advised but not required.
cave slime.wiki: 'Cave slimes are found in two rooms of the Lumbridge Swamp Caves. A rope is needed if you have not entered the dungeon before. A light source is also required'; LocLine: Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon (AJQ).

chaos druid.notes: No task page. Krystilia only, so only Wilderness spots count: Edgeville Dungeon (Wilderness part) and the Chaos Temple (Wilderness), where Elder Chaos druids count (Krystilia's table lists them under Chaos druids). Taverley Dungeon, Chaos Druid Tower (46 Thieving), Yanille Agility Dungeon (57 Agility or 82 Thieving) and Slepe church are outside the Wilderness.
chaos druid.wiki: Krystilia table: 'Chaos druids | Edgeville Dungeon, Chaos Temple (Elder Chaos druids)'. Chaos druid locations: Top of Slepe Church; Chaos Druid Tower; Edgeville Dungeon (Wilderness); Taverley Dungeon; Yanille Agility Dungeon.

locationGates.note: Wiki Neypotzli: 'Accessing Neypotzli requires having gained access during the Perilous Moons quest' (partial).

cockatrice.notes: There's no task page. Cockatrice and its superior Cockathrice are in the Fremennik Slayer Cave; Moonlight Cockatrice is in Neypotzli (partial Perilous Moons). The Bloodthirsty Cockathrice is league-only. Cockatrice tasks also need 20 Defence to wield a mirror shield.
cockatrice.wiki: 'A mirror shield or V's shield is required to defend against their piercing gaze ... players who do not meet this requirement will not be assigned them as a task.'

locationGates.note: Gate applies to Brutus only, not the cows.

cow.notes: List matches the wiki (Cow, Cow calf, Brutus, Buffalo, Undead cow). Undead cow is at Alice's farm (Priest in Peril / Morytania).
cow.wiki: Brutus: 'Boss variant. Requires completion of The Ides of Milk.'

Partial completion.

crab.notes: The monster list matches the wiki variant table. The Gemstone Crab and hermit crabs do NOT count. No Slayer equipment.
crab.wiki: 'The Gemstone Crab and hermit crabs do not count for a Slayer task.' Crab: 'Requires partial completion of Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Pirate Pete'; Ammonite Crab: 'Requires completion of Bone Voyage'.

crawling hand.notes: Monster list correct (Crawling Hand + superior Crushing hand). Slayer Tower needs Priest in Peril, which the 'morytania' mapping already covers.
crawling hand.wiki: Meiyerditch Laboratories: 'Access to the complete laboratory is granted after the player kills the mutated bloodveld that appears during the Sins of the Father quest.'

locationGates.note: Desert heat: 'Bring waterskins to avoid dying of thirst' (not needed in the grassy area by the river near Ruins of Ullek). The Sophanem spot needs Icthlarin's Little Helper.

crocodile.notes: There's no task page. Vannaka only (combat 50). The Tombs of Amascut crocodile is a separate raid NPC and doesn't count.
crocodile.wiki: 'Crocodiles are found in the Kharidian Desert south of Pollnivneach on either side of the River Elid.'

The generated monster 'Slayer task/Custodian stalker' is a parsing artifact, so remove it. Slayer levels: juvenile 54, mature 67, elder 76. Ancient Custodian is the superior, spawned only by elders. 'Strange creature' is the quest-only variant and doesn't count. Masters: the wiki infobox lists Chaeldar (70-130), Nieve (110-170) and Mortimer, but the generated assignedBy has only Mortimer. Check Chaeldar and Nieve.
custodian stalker.wiki: Infobox: skillreq Slayer 54, otherreq Shadows of Custodia, chaeldar = 70-130, nieve = 110-170, mortimer = 80-120. Variants: Juvenile / Mature / Elder custodian stalker.

Dagannoth are there after the quest.
Already a task requirement.

dagannoth.notes: The wiki's Dagannoth Kings row lists Prime, Rex and Supreme; only Prime was generated. Remove Nightmare Zone and Reanimated versions. Dagannoth fledgelings only spawn in Bardur's room and give no XP, but they do count (Konar).
dagannoth.wiki: Monster variants row: '[[Dagannoth Prime]] [[Dagannoth Rex]] [[Dagannoth Supreme]] | Deep within the Waterbirth Island Dungeon'. Jormungand's Prison: 'After the quest, it contains dagannoth, basilisk, and basilisk knights.'

dark beast.notes: The generated monster list was empty; the page is 'Slayer task/Dark beast'. Night beast is the superior. The Deadman versions don't count.
dark beast.wiki: Locations: Iorwerth Dungeon, Mourner Tunnels; otherreq 'Started Mourning's End Part II'.

dark warrior.notes: No task page. Only Krystilia assigns this task, so only the Wilderness Dark Warriors' Fortress counts (levels 8 and 145). The Great Kourend dark warriors (south of Shayzien, Lovakengj/Arceuus woods) are not in the Wilderness. This entry supplies locations for the existing empty entry. No equipment needed.
dark warrior.wiki: 'Dark warriors are mainly found in the Dark Warriors' Fortress, a castle in level 12 to 16 Wilderness'

Desert heat: bring a waterskin (card 'Waterskin') or desert robes. Recommended, not strictly required.

Exceptions: hellhounds (incl. Skeleton Hellhound (Vet'ion)), terror dogs and Venators do NOT count. Card names: 'Temple Guardian' and 'Shadow Hound' are correct as already mapped.
dog.wiki: 'Hellhounds of any variety do not count'; 'Terror dogs also do not count'; Shadow hound: 'Requires Ring of visibility and partial completion of Desert Treasure I to access.'

Level 25-28 Wilderness. On-task only.

dust devil.notes: Monsters match (Dust devil + Choke devil). Krystilia: Wilderness Slayer Cave only. The Bloodthirsty choke devil is league-only.
dust devil.wiki: 'A facemask (or a Slayer helmet/Slayer helmet (i)) must be equipped to fight dust devils effectively.'
